annotations.title: Yearly consumption and cost of a fridge, a washing machine or heating

description: An estimate (verified: false, estimate_note with the day of the prices). kind fridge: label_kwh_year from the EU energy label (kWh/annum). kind washer: kwh_per_100_cycles from the EU energy label and washes_per_week (default 4). kind heating: area_m2 and heat_need_kwh_m2 (specific heat need for heating from the building's energy performance certificate; references: passive house 20, low-energy house 50 kWh/m² a year by ČSN 73 0540-2), source direct | heat_pump | gas_boiler with scop (heat pump, default 3) or efficiency (gas boiler, default 0.9). Answers kWh a year and the yearly and monthly cost at the price of one more kWh (median marginal price in the distributor area from energy_unit_prices, or price_per_kwh if given); `defaults` names every value that was assumed.

distributor.description: Distributor area for the price (default: the first area with priced offers).

locale.description: Language of estimate_note: cs | sk | en (default en).

price_per_kwh.description: Own price of one kWh with VAT instead of ours.
